git fetch --quiet origin main
gh pr list --state open --base main --author app/github-actions --limit 100 --json number,headRefName,createdAt,labels,url,isCrossRepository
gh pr view 10 --json headRefOid,statusCheckRollup
git fetch --quiet origin main +refs/heads/update/a-2.0:refs/remotes/origin/update/a-2.0
git rev-parse origin/update/a-2.0
git merge-base --is-ancestor origin/main 1000000000000000000000000000000000000000
gh pr view 10 --json state,labels
git push --quiet origin 1000000000000000000000000000000000000000:refs/heads/main
git rev-parse --short 1000000000000000000000000000000000000000
git fetch --quiet origin main
gh pr view 10 --json state --jq .state
gh pr view 10 --json state --jq .state
git push --quiet origin --delete update/a-2.0
gh workflow run ci.yml --ref main
